name: Billink – Achteraf Betalen
author: Billink

sections.description:
Nederlands / Dutch

Bied achteraf betalen aan in jouw eigen stijl

Geef jouw klanten de mogelijkheid om eerst hun bestelling te ontvangen en daarna pas te betalen. Je biedt achteraf betalen aan in jullie eigen stijl, met jullie logo en kleuren.

  • Optimale klantervaring: De consument blijft tijdens het achteraf betalen in jouw vertrouwde checkout, volledig in de branding van jouw webshop.
  • Conversieverhogend: Achteraf betalen verhoogt het vertrouwen in jouw webshop en daarmee de conversie. Je geeft consumenten de mogelijkheid om hun bestelling eerst te ontvangen en te beoordelen, en daarna pas te betalen.
  • Volledige ontzorging: Billink verzorgt de techniek, facturatie en het debiteurenbeheer. Hiermee wordt het wanbetalingsrisico volledig uit handen genomen.

Uniek: Achteraf betalen in jouw logo en kleuren.

Je B2C of B2B klant bestelt in jouw vertrouwde checkout en kiest voor achteraf betalen, volledig in jouw eigen stijl, dus met jouw eigen logo en kleuren. Na de bestelling ontvangt de klant via Billink de factuur en betaalt deze binnen 14 dagen.

Billink als factoringspartner

De techniek, factoring en afhandeling worden achter de schermen voor je geregeld. Zo voeg je eenvoudig achteraf betalen toe aan je checkout, zonder zelf een debiteurenteam op te zetten of processen voor facturatie en opvolging in te richten!

Het risico op wanbetaling wordt volledig afgedekt. Dankzij slimme creditcheck-technologie in de checkout bied je de consument altijd een veilige alternatieve route aan om de order af te kunnen ronden.

Billink bouwt al 15+ jaar aan de techniek voor veilig achteraf betalen op factuur voor zowel B2B als B2C en doet dit voor duizenden webshops en miljoenen consumenten.

Snel te integreren

Met de kant-en-klare WooCommerce-plugin voeg je achteraf betalen eenvoudig toe aan je webshop.

Zo werkt het

  1. De klant kiest in jouw checkout voor achteraf betalen.
  2. Billink regelt de techniek en voert de benodigde checks uit.
  3. Jij verwerkt en verzendt de bestelling. Billink verzorgt de facturatie.
  4. Billink verzorgt de verdere betaalafhandeling en het debiteurenbeheer.

Alles geregeld rondom achteraf betalen

Van technologie tot service: je hoeft de processen rondom achteraf betalen niet zelf te regelen. Zo bied je jouw klanten de zekerheid van betalen na ontvangst, terwijl jij als webshop wordt ontzorgd.

De factoring en afhandeling achter deze betaaloplossing worden verzorgd door Billink, specialist in achteraf betalen voor e-commerce.

Meer informatie

Bezoek onze website zakelijk.billink.nl voor meer informatie. Wil je starten met het aanbieden van achteraf betalen? Neem contact op via sales@billink.nl of 010 – 41 41 473.
Wil je meer informatie over deze plugin? Bezoek dan de website van Tussendoor.

Engels / English

Achteraf Betalen in your own style

Give your customers the option to receive their order first and pay afterwards. You can offer achteraf betalen entirely in your own style, featuring your own logo and brand colours.

  • Optimal customer experience: Customers remain in your familiar checkout environment when choosing achteraf betalen, fully branded to match your online store.
  • Increase conversion: Achteraf betalen builds trust in your online store and can therefore help increase conversion. Customers have the option to receive and assess their order first and only pay afterwards.
  • Complete peace of mind: Billink takes care of the technology, invoicing and accounts receivable management. This means the risk of non-payment is fully taken off your hands.

Unique: Offer achteraf betalen with your own logo and brand colours.

Your B2C or B2B customer places an order through your familiar checkout and chooses achteraf betalen, entirely in your own style, with your own logo and colours. After placing the order, the customer receives an invoice via Billink and pays it within 14 days.

Billink as your factoring partner

The technology, factoring and processing are all taken care of behind the scenes. This makes it easy to add achteraf betalen to your checkout without having to set up your own accounts receivable team or implement processes for invoicing and payment follow-up.

The risk of non-payment is fully covered. Thanks to smart credit-check technology integrated into the checkout, customers can always be offered a secure alternative way to complete their order.

For more than 15 years, Billink has been developing technology for secure achteraf betalen by invoice for both B2B and B2C customers. Today, Billink provides its services to thousands of online stores and millions of consumers.

Quick to integrate

With the ready-to-use WooCommerce plugin, you can easily add achteraf betalen to your online store.

How it works

  1. The customer chooses achteraf betalen in your checkout.
  2. Billink provides the technology and performs the required checks.
  3. You process and ship the order. Billink takes care of invoicing.
  4. Billink handles the rest of the payment process and accounts receivable management.

Everything taken care of

From technology to service: you don’t have to manage the processes involved in achteraf betalen yourself. This allows you to give your customers the reassurance of paying after receiving their order, while taking the administrative burden off your online store.

The factoring and processing behind this payment solution are provided by Billink, a specialist in achteraf betalen for e-commerce.

More information

Visit our website, zakelijk.billink.nl, for more information. Would you like to start offering achteraf betalen? Contact us at sales@billink.nl or 010 – 41 41 473.
Would you like more information about this plugin? Visit the Tussendoor website.

sections.changelog:
3.5.2

  • Updated: The WooCommerce payment settings now show the orange Billink icon instead of the black one, square like the other payment methods

3.5.1

  • Updated: The checkout no longer mentions Billink. The default description is now “Betaal 14 dagen na het ontvangen van jouw producten” and the payment costs are listed as “Kosten achteraf betalen”
  • Updated: In the WooCommerce payment settings the payment method is listed as “Billink”, with the Billink logo
  • Updated: Shops still using the default description of an earlier version are migrated to the new one; texts you set yourself are left untouched

3.5.0

  • Updated: The payment method is now presented as “Achteraf betalen” with the official Achteraf betalen badge, following the Billink brand guidelines
  • Updated: Existing shops still using the old default title and description are migrated automatically; texts you set yourself are left untouched
  • Fixed: The bundled Dutch translation is now actually loaded. It was shipped but never used, so Dutch shops saw English texts in their checkout
  • Fixed: Resolved a “Translation loading was triggered too early” notice by loading translatable configuration on the init hook
  • Fixed: On a fresh install the checkout showed the payment method without a name, and the block checkout hid it altogether, until the settings screen had been saved once

3.4.0

  • Updated: Included order fee items in Billink Midpage transaction conversion so invoice fee lines are sent correctly
  • Updated: Improved session handling for selected payment method and company name, with more robust fee processing logic
  • Updated: Improved price and rounding handling in order lines to prevent calculation differences
  • Updated: Improved PostcodeCheckout address handling by trimming whitespace and composing billing address fields more reliably
  • Fixed: Corrected script registration variable names for payment cost and workflow scripts
  • Updated: Refined payment workflow handling with more consistent process_payment return behavior and improved error handling

3.3.0

  • Added: Support for checkout’s made with the WordPress Block Editor

3.2.2

  • Updated: Remove unused handleNewOrder method and improve order status scheduling logic in Gateway and Schedule classes
  • Updated: Refactor GatewayController to streamline style loading and enhance payment gateway registration

3.0.0

  • Major release: Now utilizing the Billink midpage for payment processing and payment authorisation. Because of that the core code that was responsible for these functions is now cleaned up.
  • Changed: Bumped minimal PHP version to 8.2
